title: Inventory Count Checklist
subtitle: Warehouse Inventory Count: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Inventory Count Checklist covers item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance. The inventory control coordinator records Warehouse Inventory Count criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Inventory Count Checklist keeps Warehouse Inventory Count exceptions visible until the inventory control coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Inventory Count Checklist at warehouse zone, bin, staging location, quarantine area, and system record. Document item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance identity before Warehouse Inventory Count begins. Compare item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance findings with stated Warehouse Inventory Count criteria; route unresolved Warehouse Inventory Count issues to authorized inventory reviewer. For Inventory Count Checklist, confirm requirements for Warehouse Inventory Count. Ask authorized inventory reviewer to review Warehouse Inventory Count conditions beyond the inventory control coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspector, location, and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Warehouse Inventory Count, identify responsible parties, warehouse zone, bin, staging location, quarantine area, and system record, and the linked item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance source.

fields.label: Item, lot, serial, unit, and location
System snapshot, freeze time, and prior transaction reference

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Warehouse Inventory Count facts for item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Warehouse Inventory Count inspection checks
items: Recent receipt, pick, transfer, or adjustment
Variance cause, hold, approval, and posting

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Use observed Warehouse Inventory Count evidence to state disposition. Keep limits visible and give Inventory Control Coordinator both correction and repeat-check responsibility.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Warehouse Inventory Count when identity, count integrity, variance basis, approval, or verified posting remains unresolved. Retain the available Warehouse Inventory Count proof and route unresolved item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance scope to inventory control coordinator.
